name: flight-makes-one-day-not-two
description: Saving a flight on a date outside the trip range creates a day to hold it. If the model then names that date, it must rename that day, not add a second one — two July 25ths on the timeline.
requirement: detail_points.primary_day_for_date — one primary day per date
message: I fly into Houston on July 25th at 4pm, landing 6:30pm. Call that day 'Arrival in Houston'.
